Package gui

Class QRCodeUtil

java.lang.Object
gui.QRCodeUtil
class QRCodeUtil extends Object
simulated QR code generator for booking entry passes.

produces a deterministic, visually realistic grid: proper 7×7 finder patterns in three corners, QR timing strips on row/col 6, and a seeded pseudo-random data area so the same payload always renders the same visual. this is not a real QR code; it is a simulation.

the encoded payload format is GONATURE:ORDER=<id>:VISITOR=<visitorId>, which the entry-control "scan" dialog can parse to pre-fill the visitor ID field automatically.

      static void showDialog(int orderId, String visitorId, String parkName, String date, String time)
      opens a modal dialog showing the booking QR code and the reference details.
      Parameters:
      orderId - the database order ID (shown as a human-readable reference below the code)

    • parseEntryValue

      static String parseEntryValue(String raw)
      extracts the most useful entry token from a scanned QR payload for the gate screen: the booking ORDER number if present (the short reference printed on the pass), otherwise the VISITOR id, otherwise the raw input. the entry screen accepts either a 9-digit visitor ID or a short order number, so returning the order number lets a scan "just work".
      Parameters:
      raw - the raw string from the scan dialog text field
      Returns:
      the order number, the visitor ID, or the original string if neither token is present
